supporter.title: Cellarion is free, and open-source. Here's what keeps it running.
supporter.subtitle: Every feature is free for everyone, forever — no paywalls, nothing locked. But the servers and AI behind the app cost real money. If Cellarion has earned a place in your cellar, you're warmly invited to help split the tab.
supporter.allFeaturesNote: All features are free for everyone. Supporting is a voluntary donation that unlocks nothing extra — it simply funds development.

supporter.freeBody: Cellarion is open-source under the AGPL-3.0 license, and every feature is free for everyone — unlimited cellars, all the stats, drink-window alerts, and 50 Cellar Chat questions a day. Supporting unlocks nothing extra, because nothing is locked: supporters and free users get the exact same app.
supporter.costsHeading: What your support actually pays for
supporter.costsBody: Behind the scenes there's a server running around the clock, the cellarion.app domain, and the paid AI that powers Cellar Chat — Anthropic Claude answers your questions and Voyage handles the wine-matching behind them. Those bills arrive every month and grow as more people pour a glass and start chatting.
supporter.whereCaption: Honest, qualitative buckets — no tier buys anything different.
supporter.donateLead: Want to help split the tab?
supporter.donateBody: Same app, same features either way — just our genuine thanks.
supporter.reassure: Cancel anytime · same app either way 💛
supporter.alreadySupporting: 💛 You're supporting Cellarion — thank you! You can change or cancel anytime.
supporter.donateNote: Payments are handled securely by Stripe. Cellarion stays free and open whether you support or not.

cellars.title: Cellars
cellars.summary: Create cellars to organize your wine collection.
cellars.d1: Create cellars by clicking "+ New Cellar" and typing a name.
cellars.d2: Each cellar is a separate bottle collection.
cellars.d3: Open a cellar to see all its bottles. Filter by search, vintage, rating. Sort by newest/oldest/price/rating.
cellars.d4: Cellar overview tab shows: bottle count, total value, and links to Racks and Room View.

bottles.title: Bottles
bottles.summary: Add, manage, and track individual bottles in your cellars.
bottles.d1: Add a bottle: click "+ Add Bottle" in a cellar. Two ways: search the wine database by name, OR scan a wine label with your phone camera to identify the wine automatically.
bottles.d2: Bottle detail page shows: wine info, vintage, price paid, market value estimate, your rating, your notes, images, grape varieties, aging & maturity status, price evolution chart.
bottles.d3: Edit details: click "Edit Details" on the bottle page to change vintage, price, rating, notes, size.
bottles.d4: Upload photos: on the bottle detail page, you can add photos of the bottle or label. Background removal is automatic.
bottles.d5: Share a bottle: click the share icon on the bottle detail page to send a link to someone.
bottles.d6: Consume/remove: click "Remove Bottle" to mark it as consumed. Set the date you drank it. The bottle moves to the cellar's history.
bottles.d7: Write a review: on the bottle detail page, scroll down to write a community review.

labelScan.title: Label Scanning
labelScan.summary: Scan a wine label with your camera to identify it automatically.
labelScan.d1: Available when adding a bottle — click the camera button.
labelScan.d2: Take a photo of the wine label and we'll read it and identify the wine for you.
labelScan.d3: Works with most printed labels. Best results with clear, well-lit photos.
labelScan.d4: After scanning, the wine details are pre-filled. Review and save.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.summary: Share cellars with friends or send a link to a specific bottle.
sharing.d1: Share a cellar: open a cellar → click the "..." menu → Share. Invite someone by email as Viewer (can browse) or Editor (can add/remove bottles). Only the cellar owner can share.
sharing.d2: Share a bottle: on any bottle detail page, click the share icon to send a direct link to someone.

racks.title: Racks
racks.summary: Organize bottles in physical rack grids that match your real storage.
racks.d1: Access racks: open a cellar → click the "..." menu → Racks.
racks.d2: Choose from multiple rack types: standard grid, X-rack, hexagonal honeycomb, triangle (A-frame), vertical stack, modular cube, or open shelf.
racks.d3: Customize each rack with a name, size, and layout that matches your real storage.
racks.d4: Place bottles into rack slots by clicking an empty slot and selecting a bottle.
racks.d5: Visual grid shows which slots are filled and which are empty.

roomView.title: 3D Room View
roomView.summary: Build a 3D virtual room that mirrors your real cellar.
roomView.d1: Access: open a cellar → overview tab → Room View.
roomView.d2: Place and arrange your racks in a virtual 3D room.
roomView.d3: Click "Edit" to enter edit mode: drag racks, rotate them, add unplaced racks.
roomView.d4: Click "Save" to keep your layout. Come back anytime to rearrange.

wishlist.title: Wishlist

landing.heroSubline: The modern way to track your wine collection. Log every bottle, visualise your racks, get drink-window alerts at the perfect moment, and share cellars with friends — all in one private, ad-free app.
landing.aboutText: Cellarion is a wine cellar management app for collectors, restaurants, and weekend enthusiasts. Track every bottle in your collection — vintage, producer, region, price, personal rating, and tasting notes. Organise wines across cellars and racks, get drink-window alerts so you never miss a wine's peak, and share cellars with friends. Free to use at cellarion.app.
landing.featuresSub: From a single bottle to a thousand, Cellarion keeps your collection organised and drinkable.
landing.featureBottleDesc: Log every bottle in your collection — vintage, producer, region, price, personal rating, and tasting notes, all in one place.
landing.featureCellarDesc: Organize bottles across multiple cellars and visualize your physical racks on an interactive grid. Know exactly where each bottle lives.
landing.featureDrinkDesc: Get notified when a bottle is approaching its peak or past it. Never open a great wine too early — or too late.
landing.featureStatsDesc: Explore your cellar with charts and maps — breakdown by country, grape, value, drink status, and more.
landing.featureSearchDesc: Fuzzy matching and deduplication so you always find the right wine, even with a typo.
landing.featureShareDesc: Invite friends or colleagues to browse or co-manage a cellar. Granular role-based access keeps you in control.
landing.featureLabelDesc: Snap a photo of the label and we'll fill in the details. Background removal keeps bottle images clean and beautiful.
landing.featureImportDesc: Bring your existing collection in via CSV. A structured wine registry shared across users ensures clean, consistent data.
landing.whySub: Built around the things that actually matter when you care about your collection.
landing.whyFreeDesc: All core features are free at cellarion.app — no credit card, no trial, no upsell pop-ups. We don't sell ads either.
landing.whyExportDesc: Your collection is yours. Export everything as JSON — or a ZIP with your images — with one click, any time. If you ever leave, you walk out with all your data.
landing.whyPrivacyDesc: No third-party trackers, no data sold to wine merchants. Just a clean app that stays out of your way.
landing.whyGdprDesc: Hosted on European infrastructure. Full data export, account deletion, and a one-click email opt-out built in from day one.
landing.finalSub: Create a free account at cellarion.app and have your first bottle logged in under a minute.
landing.metaTitle: Cellarion — Wine Cellar App | Track Your Wine Collection Online
landing.metaDescription: Track your wine collection with Cellarion. Log every bottle, visualise racks, get drink-window alerts, and share cellars with friends. Free wine cellar app at cellarion.app.
landing.faqSub: Quick answers about Cellarion, wine cellar management, and how to get started.

faq.a1: Cellarion is a wine cellar management app that helps you track every bottle in your collection. Log vintage, producer, region, price, personal rating, and tasting notes; organise bottles across cellars and racks; get drink-window alerts when wines approach their peak; and share cellars with friends or co-managers. It's free to use at cellarion.app.
faq.q2: How do I track my wine collection with Cellarion?
faq.a2: You log each bottle with its vintage, producer, region, price, personal rating, and tasting notes. Bottles live inside named cellars and can be placed on customisable racks for visual organisation. Cellarion automatically calculates drink windows, tracks consumption history, and gives you statistics across your whole collection.
faq.q3: What is a drink window in wine?
faq.a3: A drink window is the period during which a wine is at its best — typically a range of years bracketing the wine's peak maturity. Cellarion classifies every vintage as Not Ready, Early, Peak, Late, or Declining based on producer notes and vintage data, so you know which bottles to drink soon and which to keep cellaring.
faq.a4: Yes. All core features at cellarion.app are free — track unlimited bottles, organise cellars, get drink-window alerts, share with friends, and export your data anytime. There are no credit-card prompts, no premium tiers gating basic functionality, and we don't sell ads or your data.
faq.q5: How do I import wines from Vivino or CellarTracker?
faq.a5: Cellarion supports CSV import. Export your collection from Vivino, CellarTracker, or any spreadsheet, then upload the CSV in Cellarion's import tool. The shared wine registry deduplicates entries automatically so your data stays clean and consistent across the whole catalogue.
faq.q6: Can I export my data and leave any time?
faq.a6: Yes — your data is yours. Cellarion includes a one-click data export that gives you everything as JSON, plus CSV import and export for bottles. You can delete your account from Settings with a 7-day cooling-off window. Hosted data lives on European infrastructure under GDPR.
